claims.verbatim:
Steamship City of London (Br), Mirehouse, Liverpool April
18, via Queenstown 19th, with mdse and passengers, to John
G Dale. 18th ult, off Point Lynas, saw ship Webster; 19th,
[illegible] steamers California[?], Helvetia[?], and City of [cut]
Baltimore, bound to Liverpool; 20th, 25 miles W of Fastnet, a
brig rigged steamer, and a bark rigged steamer, supposed the
China, bound E; 11 PM, steamship Queen; 23d, lat 47 45, lon
28 30, ship Dublin, bound W; 24th, lat 46, lon 33, a bark rig-
ged steamer bound E, supposed the St George; 25th, lat 45,
lon 38 40, ship Universe, bound W; 28th, lat 42 15 lon 56, a
Hamburg brig, showing No 117; 29th, lat 41 50, lon 61 30,
steamer Carroll, from Baltimore for Liverpool.
